title: Hawaii's Bronson Rivera awaits MLB Draft future - NewsBreak
text: Hawaii Pacific baseball standout Bronson Rivera hopes to hear his named called in the 2025 MLB Draft. Rivera who had an impressive season where he broke HPU’s single season home run record with 19 and took home 2nd Team All-American honors. Now, the Konawaena alum is ready for the chance to play in the Pro’s. “It’s the one and only dream I’ve had. So yeah, definitely a definitely feels good to be put in the position to. Ah, hopefully I can continue playing at that next level,” said Rivera. But despite whatever may or may not happen, Rivera is just thankful to be in the position that he is. “I think I’m definitely blessed to be in this opportunity to where I can hopefully continue playing professionally at the next level. That’s always been my goal. So hopefully that all works out, but no expectations going into it, really just continuing to just work and stay ready for if opportunity comes. But whatever happens, happens and it’s all God’s plan,” said Rivera. The HPU standout also was named the PacWest Conference Newcomer of the Year Award. The MLB Draft will be held July 13th-14th with rounds 1-3 on Sunday, followed by rounds 4-20 on Monday. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to KHON2.
